statement: The pinned Series Bluetooth descriptor and xpadneo consumer define output 0x03 as a four-bit motor selection mask, four magnitude bytes with logical range 0–100, duration and delay in 10 ms ticks (0–255), and an unsigned loop-count byte. Consumer quirks can reorder mask bits; this records the ordinary mask, not every hardware variant or physical timing behavior.

applicability.revision: standard Series descriptor example at xpadneo 56b538d; retail firmware variant not established
applicability.scope: xpadneo docs/descriptors/xbxs.md:123-165; xpadneo.h:55-105; rumble.c:56-137; SDL_hidapi_xboxone.c:564-574. Source-only logical layout and consumer behavior; no physical test.
